final_project_goal: Use CF4 constraints to obtain a statistically valid z=0 local-universe density/velocity posterior, construct an exact q-corrected initial condition with conditional high-k structure, and forward-validate a zoom IC at an effective observational resolution of <=0.3 cMpc/h.
purpose: Replace the unresolved point-deposit GH/TSC radial convolution with a mass-preserving, numerically convergent line-of-sight convolution before any posterior, IC, or zoom claim is considered.

final_goal_alignment.necessity: An unresolved observation operator biases the z=0 posterior and therefore invalidates any downstream IC or forward-validation conclusion.
final_goal_alignment.sufficiency: This bundle is necessary but not sufficient for the final goal; it does not by itself establish a z=0 posterior, high-k completion, IC, PM/HOP validation, or the <=0.3 cMpc/h claim.

fable_audit.summary: Q1 is a necessary numerical prerequisite because the current GH/TSC boundary mismatch directly contaminates the z=0 posterior. Implementation is conditional on the operator, candidate-vs-oracle gate, and numerical tolerances below being frozen first.
required_amendments: Freeze the periodic-torus expectation operator before implementation.
Use a new candidate-versus-oracle error gate; do not treat the failing GH3-versus-GH7 gate as a Q1 pass criterion.
Freeze JAX-versus-oracle, fallback, and tail-truncation tolerances numerically before implementation.
Define exposure-weighted mass conservation with both relative and absolute tolerances.

frozen_operator.name: periodic_torus_expected_cell_response
frozen_operator.equation: lambda_pc = E_epsilon [ sum_i m_pi W_TSC(c, (s_i + h*sigma_i*epsilon*rhat_i/(a*H)) mod L) ]

definitions.rhat_i: observer-centred LOS direction computed from the coherent-RSD input position before the stochastic displacement
definitions.epsilon: standard-normal line-of-sight displacement variate with the declared Gaussian/FoG convention
definitions.W_TSC: periodic cell-integrated TSC response, not point-deposit TSC
definitions.lambda_pc: expected exposure-free cell mass/intensity before selection exposure is applied

frozen_operator.periodic_wrapping: Apply modulo L to every stochastic displacement before evaluating the periodic cell response.
frozen_operator.exposure_order: Evaluate the exposure-free convolution first; multiply by the already calibrated per-population exposure only after convolution.

work_packages.task: Implement a NumPy oracle for Gaussian LOS convolution integrated over the piecewise TSC/cell response, using an analytic piecewise-polynomial/erf form where practical and a deterministic high-accuracy fallback only for oracle verification.
work_packages.acceptance: No point-deposit approximation is used by the oracle; input mass and periodic support are explicit, and the frozen torus expectation operator is implemented exactly as specified.

work_packages.task: Compare the Q1 oracle against the current GH/TSC point-deposit method and GH7/GH9/GH15 on both boundary and non-boundary fixtures.
work_packages.acceptance: Report total and per-population relative L1 errors, extrema, exact frozen fixture identifiers, and candidate-versus-oracle errors against the new 0.005 gate. The old GH3-versus-GH7 failure is diagnostic only, not a Q1 pass criterion.

work_packages.task: Verify periodic mass conservation, non-negativity where required by the response, deterministic reproducibility, and finite derivatives of the eventual differentiable implementation.
work_packages.acceptance: Exposure-free convolution mass passes both relative <= 1e-10 and absolute <= 1e-12 gates per population and in total. Exposure-weighted totals are compared candidate-versus-oracle with relative <= 1e-10 and absolute <= 1e-12; they are not falsely required to conserve mass after selection exposure. No NaN/Inf.

work_packages.task: After NumPy reference agreement, implement the JAX counterpart and compare it to the oracle without changing the frozen tolerance or fixture.
work_packages.acceptance: JAX-versus-oracle relative L1 <= 1e-6 and absolute L1 <= 1e-10; fallback-versus-analytic <= 1e-8 and tail-truncation <= 1e-8 are recorded. For position, velocity, FoG sigma, and population-mass derivatives, JAX AD versus finite-difference/oracle checks pass relative <= 1e-5 and absolute <= 1e-8, including periodic boundaries and TSC knots; all x64/shape/ownership checks remain fail-closed.

release_gates: The Q1 candidate-versus-oracle boundary and non-boundary errors pass the frozen 0.005 criterion; the criterion may not be relaxed.

Per-population results and exposure-free periodic mass conservation pass both relative and absolute gates; exposure-weighted totals agree between candidate and oracle without a false post-selection conservation claim.
Gradient agreement and boundary/knot continuity are checked for every differentiable input class before JAX promotion.
A synthetic benchmark records peak memory, particles per second, JIT compile cost, and gradient cost; the operator is not mathematically changed to meet a performance target.
NumPy oracle and JAX implementation agree before any likelihood expansion.
No observational posterior, conditional high-k, IC, PM/HOP, zoom, or <=0.3 cMpc/h science claim is authorized by Q1 alone.

audit_request.focus: Audit whether this Q1 bundle is the correct next prerequisite for the final CF4-to-z=0-posterior-to-IC-to-forward-validation goal, identify missing gates or scope creep, and state GO/CONDITIONAL-GO/NO-GO.
